acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given `spec/index.md` plus N component files with large design bodies, when `pm-phase1`'s validation step builds the main validator's prompt, then the prompt contains the Tech-Spec skeleton content but none of the per-component Change/Algorithm/Schema/Tests prose

Given a component's Addresses column references an AC-ID absent from `req/index.md`'s AC table, when `pm-phase1`'s validation step runs, then a deterministic `"Tech-Spec: ..."` finding is produced and `needsTechSpecFix` is forced true

Given an AC-ID in `req/index.md`'s AC table is referenced by zero Tech-Spec components, when `pm-phase1`'s validation step runs, then a deterministic `"Tech-Spec: ..."` finding is produced and `needsTechSpecFix` is forced true

Given the main validator returns `valid: true` with empty `findings`/`needsComponentDetail`, but AC-02 or AC-03's condition holds, when `pm-phase1`'s validation step runs, then the merged result is not treated as valid; the correct fix flag is forced true and the revision cycle continues

Given no deterministic structural gaps exist and no `needsComponentDetail` entries are produced, when the main validator independently returns `valid: true`, then the merged result is valid, unchanged behavior from today

Given a claim needs component-body detail to verify (not visible in Purpose/Addresses/Domain), when the main validator runs, then it returns a `needsComponentDetail` entry `{ claim, fileSlug }` naming a real, existing skeleton row, instead of guessing or silently dropping the check

Given a `needsComponentDetail` entry names a `fileSlug` that exists in `spec/index.md`'s table, when the host processes the main validator's result, then a drill-down worker call is dispatched, Reading only that component's file (and any others batched with it)

Given a `needsComponentDetail` entry names a `fileSlug` absent from `spec/index.md`'s table, when the host processes the main validator's result, then the entry is dropped before dispatch and a `"Tech-Spec: ..."` finding about the bad reference is produced instead
Given the drill-down worker reads a named component and confirms the claim is satisfied by its content, when the drill-down call completes, then no finding is added for that claim

Given the drill-down worker reads a named component and the claim is NOT satisfied by its content, when the drill-down call completes, then a `"Tech-Spec: ..."` finding is added, merged into the overall result, forcing `needsTechSpecFix`

Given `needsComponentDetail` names more unique components than the batch size `K`, when the host dispatches drill-down calls, then `ceil(N/K)` batched calls are issued, each bounded to at most `K` components — never one call covering all of them

Given two `needsComponentDetail` entries name the same `fileSlug`, when the host processes the main validator's result, then the component is deduplicated to a single read/batch slot, both claims checked against it

Given a validation cycle completes (clean or not), regardless of whether drill-down ran, when `docsDigest` is computed, then it still hashes the full, unreduced `assembledRequirements`/`assembledTechSpec` content
Given all changes are delivered, when `npm test` runs, then all tests pass: new regression tests for AC-01 through AC-13, and a full-suite regression
